usage: agent-run resume [-h] (--task TASK | --task-file TASK_FILE)
                        [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--request-id REQUEST_ID]
                        [--session-transport SESSION_TRANSPORT]
                        [--session-id SESSION_ID]
                        [--session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID]
                        agent_id

positional arguments:
  agent_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --task TASK
  --task-file TASK_FILE
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --request-id REQUEST_ID
  --session-transport SESSION_TRANSPORT
  --session-id SESSION_ID
  --session-turn-id SESSION_TURN_ID
